user_goal: Build and externally verify AGI as quickly as possible without weakening the evidence gate.
active_system_definition: The current task-chat model executing the repository Engine, Skills, scoped Candidates, Episodes, Memory, self-application adapter, evidence, safety, and continuation procedures is the active unfinished intelligence system under development.
claim_boundary: No architecture, model choice, self-application record, internal benchmark, CI result, Candidate promotion, repository-authored evaluator, Copilot campaign, or weakened policy can establish AGI. A verified claim requires the conservative independent production evidence gate to pass on genuinely external signed evidence across all required criteria and evaluator groups with no unresolved contamination or admissible failures.
completed_through: The system now includes the previously retained bounded learning/transfer/materialization/evidence infrastructure plus an observable live Copilot path. Workflow 32090346077 produced two strict capability/workspace repeats at suite_score 1.0 and falsified a request/runtime long-horizon bound. PR167 preserved that counterexample, shared the sandbox minimum with request validation, passed corrected exact-head CI and merged. Fresh workflow 32094156066 then proved the minimum-valid three-instance request reaches both capability/workspace and long-horizon model stages, but both were externally blocked when Copilot reported monthly quota exhausted. This provider resource exhaustion is retained separately from semantic capability evidence. These remain internal development results, not verified AGI.
